mapper.sql: a.achievement_id, a.management_no, a.teacher_user_id, COALESCE(k.name, u.login_id) AS teacher_name, a.organization_code, a.evaluation_year, a.management_item_code, a.achievement_date, d.performance_detail, a.achievement_status, a.attachment_ref, a.created_at, a.updated_at

FROM education_achievements a JOIN course_operation_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id LEFT JOIN korus_personnel_snapshots k ON k.employee_no = u.employee_no
